desc: Ideation: reduce to three literal blocks and identify occurrence-combination approaches.

Implement Solution.shortestMatchingSubstring by splitting p into A,B,C, filtering to nonempty blocks in order, returning 0 if none; find occurrences of each nonempty block in s with KMP (cache duplicates); for 1 block return its length if it occurs; for 2 blocks iterate occurrences of the second and use bisect_right on the first list with threshold start - len(first) to get the latest non-overlapping first occurrence, minimizing second_start - first_start + len(second); for 3 blocks iterate middle occurrences, use bisect_right for latest first with threshold mid - len(first) and bisect_left for earliest third with threshold mid + len(mid), minimizing third_start - first_start + len(third); return -1 if no valid combination.

Run the current implementation on the four provided examples plus edge cases (p='**', single nonempty block, consecutive stars, 'a*a' on s='a', adjacent occurrences, no-match) and a small randomized brute-force cross-check; report SAMPLE TESTS verdict.
